scripts.build: npm run build:catalog && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:catalog && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.lint: eslint src server scripts tests vite.config.ts
scripts.check:pages: npm run lint && npm run build:pages && npm run test:static
scripts.check:server: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:server && npm run test:production && npm run test:catalog
scripts.test:static: node --import tsx tests/static-catalog.mjs && node --import tsx tests/local-state.mjs && node --import tsx tests/local-api.mjs && node tests/corpus-inventory.mjs && node --import tsx tests/i18n.mjs
